title: automation: a switched-off packaged flow is refused FLOW_DISABLED with a sentence naming sys_metadata_activation and ADR-0126 §7.2, the flow twin of the action sentence #27842 rewrites
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② a finding a dev report carried out of scope (#27842's os-dev-report 6515747732, out-of-scope finding 2; PR #27964). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (the code is `packages/services/service-automation`).
Reader: the lane triage assigns; one small PR.
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "FLOW_DISABLED message names sys_metadata_activation ADR plain sentence end user flow switched off describeDisabledFlow" → 14 hits. #27504 is the action button and toast (its serve half is #27842); #26474 / #26506 are the switch's actor; #20678 is the subflow-disable remedy; #23316 is the flow registration read. None rewrites the `FLOW_DISABLED` sentence. **New.**
reach: read in code on `origin/main`, not driven through a public door. Any caller of a packaged flow an administrator switched off under Setup › Packaged automation that reads the refusal's `error` text: the run door's `FLOW_DISABLED` envelope (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:5765`, `dag-traversal.ts:1144`).

## What the code says

`describeDisabledFlow` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/subflow-guards.ts:47–57`) answers a flow switched off in the activation ledger with:

> Flow 'NAME' is disabled — it is switched off for this installation in the packaged-metadata activation ledger (sys_metadata_activation, ADR-0126 §7.2). Re-enable the packaged flow to arm it again, or run a clone of it under a new name.

It names a system table and an ADR section in a string a person reads. That is what AGENTS.md's runtime-string rule forbids ("the lesson goes into the text"). PR #27964 (#27842) rewrites the action twin, `ActionActivationProjection.describeDisabled()`, to "This action is turned off for this deployment. An administrator can turn it on again under Setup › Packaged automation, or you can use another action.", with `ACTION_DISABLED` / 409 kept and the ledger + ADR moved to a log line.

## Wanted

- The ledger branch of `describeDisabledFlow` says the same thing in plain words, in the action sentence's shape: what happened, who can undo it and where, and what the caller can do meanwhile. The `FLOW_DISABLED` code stays; the table and ADR reference go to a log line, as #27842 does for actions. Whether "run a clone of it under a new name" stays depends on whether flow clone is chartered (ADR-0126 §7.2); measure that, and do not advertise machinery that does not exist.
- The status-dimension sentence (`Flow 'NAME' is disabled`) is out of scope.
- Flip every pin of the old sentence in one pass (grep the sentence and `FLOW_DISABLED` repo-wide, including `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`, which the #27842 dev reports keys on that message).

Lands after PR #27964, so the two sentences end up in one shape. **Clause-②:** `no`. **Metadata-protocol:** `none`.

Blocked-by: #27964
